subject: ivy-emberose
label: The Radio of Trans Girl Safety
to: A radio built by Uncle James, powered by love and devotion
note:
Ivy was SOLD to St. Jonah's by her parents for being too soft and too feminine to stand beside their heir, sorted into Flight 06 and held in reserve for the Pleasures pool — her ID, 06-203, says exactly what they intended. She gardened anyway. She was also the only person permitted to visit Evie's cell, BECAUSE IT MADE EVIE OBEDIENT.

She came back from that jumpy, undone by loud noises, and asked Bryn for a plot behind the apartment. Shy but confident. Then she got lost on an excursion chasing rare flowers and cried behind a tree until Evie found her — and JAMES arrived with radios so it could never happen again. Now she can wander as far as she likes.
